name: Vanilla-NeRF Initialization Failure Analysis
definition: An analysis of failure modes in Vanilla-NeRF attributed to poor initialization of MLP layers (initial output distribution has 0 mean and 0 variance) and the inability of ReLU to provide a smooth transition from low to high alpha values.
summary: Vanilla-NeRF Initialization Failure Analysis diagnoses training instability caused by ReLU activations and zero-variance initialization, distinguishing it by identifying random convergence failures that alternative exponential strategies prevent.
